title: Budget decoder KV cache before admitting traffic
description: Compare attention architectures under the same model shape. Change context, concurrency, and cache budget to expose the memory boundary before a server fails.

strategies.label: Multi-head attention
strategies.detail: Every query head has its own key and value head.
strategies.tradeoff: Largest KV cache in this profile; preserves the checkpoint's full multi-head projections.

strategies.label: Grouped-query attention
strategies.detail: Groups of four query heads share one key and value head.
strategies.tradeoff: One quarter of MHA KV bytes for this shape; requires a compatible or deliberately uptrained checkpoint.

strategies.label: Multi-query attention
strategies.detail: All query heads share one key head and one value head.
strategies.tradeoff: Smallest KV cache and bandwidth demand; quality impact must be measured for the target model and task.
